scene_summary: Raised embroidery on coral-orange woven cloth: a large smiling green long-necked turtle with a cream-spotted brown shell faces a separate blue grand piano. Three cream musical symbols bridge the open field. Lavender stitch clusters and broken green perimeter ribs provide subordinate accents. The creature is the single planned source-bearing anchor.
usable_surfaces: Raised green head and curved neck embroidery
Cream-outlined brown shell with cream stitched spots

detected_object.label: Smiling green long-necked turtle with cream-spotted brown shell
detected_object.visual_evidence: The left-hand figure has a rounded green head with two dark eyes and a curved smile, a long bending green neck, a broad brown shell outlined in cream yarn, multiple cream shell spots, and short green feet beneath the shell. Dense directional stitches and small shadows visibly distinguish the raised figure from the orange woven ground. Its head faces the separate piano; no appendage touches the keyboard.
